name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 7 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 45 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-24, at wavelengths from 1.09 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
